title: KOREA RESEARCH INSTITUTE FOR LOCAL ADMINISTRATION SUPPORT ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Act is to contribute to the development of local autonomy by protecting and fostering the Korea Research Institute for Local Administration, a foundation established to comprehensively and systematically conduct research and surveys necessary for the development of local administration, finance, taxation and regional development.

Article 2 (Fund)
(1) A fund shall be established at the Korea Research Institute for Local Administration (hereinafter referred to as the "Institute") to finance its facilities and operation.
(2) The fund under paragraph (1) shall be raised from contributions by local governments and other persons.
(3) Matters necessary for the operation and management of the fund under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 3 (Contributions)
(1) The Institute shall be operated with contributions from the State and local governments and other revenue.
(2) The State shall provide contributions necessary to meet the expenses of the Institute's facilities and operation within its budget.
(3) Local governments shall provide contributions necessary to meet the expenses of the Institute's facilities and operation and the fund under Article 2 within their budgets.
(4) Matters necessary for the payment, use and management of contributions under paragraphs (2) and (3) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.

Article 4 (Lease of State-Owned and Public Property) The State or a local government may, if necessary for the Institute's facilities and operation, lease State-owned or public property to the Institute as prescribed by the State Property Act or the Public Property and Commodity Management Act, and may transfer public property without consideration notwithstanding the Public Property and Commodity Management Act.

Article 5 (Entrustment of Research and Surveys; Provision of Materials)
(1) Where the State or a local government intends to commission research or a survey relating to local autonomy, it shall give preference to the Institute over other research institutions, except where another Act provides otherwise or other special circumstances exist.
(2) The Institute may request the State, a local government, or a national or public educational or research institution to distribute publications or other materials relating to local autonomy. The institution receiving such a request shall provide the materials unless it has special grounds not to do so.
(3) Publications or other materials provided under paragraph (2) may not be used for any purpose other than research.

Article 6 (Approval of Business Plans, etc.) The Institute shall prepare its business plan and budget for each fiscal year, submit them to the Minister of the Interior and Safety, and obtain approval. The same shall apply when the Institute intends to amend them. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>

Article 7 (Submission of Statements of Settlement of Accounts) The Institute shall prepare a statement of settlement of its revenues and expenditures for each fiscal year, obtain an audit by a certified public accountant designated by the Minister of the Interior and Safety, and submit it to that Minister. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>

Article 8 (Reports, Inspections, etc.) When necessary for supervision, the Minister of the Interior and Safety may require the Institute to report on its affairs or direct public officials under the Minister's authority to inspect those affairs. <Amended Mar. 23, 2013; Nov. 19, 2014; Jul. 26, 2017>

Article 9 (Duty of Confidentiality) No current or former officer or employee of the Institute shall divulge or misappropriate secrets learned in the course of performing duties.

Article 10 (Penal Provisions) A person who violates Article 9 shall be punished by imprisonment with labor for not more than two years or by a fine not exceeding two million won.

Article 11 Deleted. <Mar. 8, 2011>

ADDENDA <Act No. 3809, May 8, 1986>
(1) (Enforcement Date) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
(2) (Transitional Measures concerning Fund) The fund of the Institute existing when this Act enters into force shall be deemed the fund under this Act.
